Dean Brewer

Independent candidate for Governor, Tennessee · Open seat

Not found in available sources

Dean Brewer is an independent candidate for Governor of Tennessee on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot. He is from Lenoir City and lives in Knoxville. He qualified for the ballot by petition at the March 10, 2026 filing deadline and is running for public office for the first time.

Background

  • Hometown: Lenoir City, Tennessee; lives in Knoxville (WSMV)
  • No prior political office; first run for public office (WSMV)
  • Qualified for the 2026 governor's ballot as an independent by petition, filed by the March 10, 2026 deadline (TNFirefly)
